tasks.title: IW-001: restore and build the solution without NU1605
acceptance: Red step: before editing, run `dotnet build src/DM-Auth.sln` from the worktree root and report the NU1605 error it prints (downgrade of Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions, `1 Error(s)`), as the session setup probe recorded at ba33897.
`dotnet restore src/DM-Auth.sln`, run from the worktree root, exits 0 and its output contains no `NU1605`.
`dotnet build src/DM-Auth.sln`, run from the worktree root, exits 0, its output contains `0 Error(s)`, and it contains no `NU1605`.

No package reference in src/DMAuth.Infrastructure/DMAuth.Infrastructure.csproj floats: `grep -c 'Version="[^"]*\*' src/DMAuth.Infrastructure/DMAuth.Infrastructure.csproj` prints 0 (it prints 3 at ba33897). Control that must not change: the same grep over src/DMAuth.Web/DMAuth.Web.csproj prints 2, which this task does not touch and which shows the predicate matches a `10.*` version and not an exact one such as `10.0.15`.

The three formerly floating packages are still referenced, each with an exact version: `grep -c -E 'Include="Microsoft\.(AspNetCore\.DataProtection\.EntityFrameworkCore|EntityFrameworkCore\.SqlServer|EntityFrameworkCore\.Tools)"' src/DMAuth.Infrastructure/DMAuth.Infrastructure.csproj` prints 3.

tasks.title: NT-001: both test projects run their tests under dotnet test (VSTest), without Azure credentials
acceptance: Red step (runner): before editing, `dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj` run from the worktree root prints no line containing `Total:`; report the output observed.

Both test projects use the VSTest runner, per discussion D6: `grep -l 'Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk"' tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/DMAuth.Tests.Integration.csproj` and `grep -l 'Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio"' tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/DMAuth.Tests.Integration.csproj` each list both files.
The repository is not switched to Microsoft.Testing.Platform mode, per discussion D6 (one runner for both): `ls global.json` run from the worktree root reports that no such file exists.

`dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj`, run from the worktree root, exits 0 and prints exactly one summary line, which reports `Failed:     0` and `Total:   234`. Census: 234 is the VSTest total the architect measured on a copy of the worktree at ba33897 with only T1's and this task's package changes applied, and equals the second count 193 `[Fact]` + 41 `[InlineData(` lines in tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit (`grep -rhoE '^\s*\[Fact(\(|\])' tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit --include=*.cs | wc -l` and `grep -rhoE '^\s*\[InlineData\(' tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit --include=*.cs | wc -l`); this task adds no unit test.

Observation (Key Vault, before the switch): with the runner packages in place and Program.cs and IntegrationTestFactory.cs not yet changed, run `dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/DMAuth.Tests.Integration.csproj` and report the summary line observed. Where tests fail, report that their errors come from `DefaultAzureCredential` / `CredentialUnavailableException` (the architect observed `Failed:   107, Passed:     0` on a scratch copy with an expired Azure CLI token); where they pass because this machine holds a valid Azure CLI login reaching the dev vault, report that instead. The switch's discrimination is demonstrated by the ProgramTests injection criterion and the UseSetting criterion, not by this observation.

The test factory turns Key Vault off through the host setting Program.cs reads, `KeyVault:Enabled` (Gate 2 D1): `grep -nE 'UseSetting\(\s*"KeyVault:Enabled"' tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/Common/IntegrationTestFactory.cs` prints at least one line (it prints nothing at ba33897), and `grep -n 'KeyVault:Enabled' src/DMAuth.Web/Program.cs` prints at least one line (nothing at ba33897).

`dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/DMAuth.Tests.Integration.csproj`, run from the worktree root, exits 0 and prints exactly one summary line, which reports `Failed:     0` and a `Total:` equal to 107 plus the number of test cases this task adds; report both numbers. Census for 107: the architect's scratch VSTest total at ba33897 plus runner and Key Vault changes, equal to 93 `[Fact]` + 14 `[InlineData(` lines in tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration counted with the two greps in the unit criterion pointed at that folder.

Program.cs keeps Key Vault on unless a declared setting turns it off (backend.md, Configuration: behaviour differing by environment is a declared configuration value, never a branch on an environment name): `grep -nE 'IsEnvironment|IsDevelopment|EnvironmentName' src/DMAuth.Web/Program.cs` prints only the line it prints at ba33897 (`if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())`, Program.cs:174 at ba33897), and the setting's default when absent is enabled.

src/DMAuth.Web/appsettings.json declares the Key Vault switch with its enabled default: `node -e "const j=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('src/DMAuth.Web/appsettings.json','utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/,''));process.exit(j.KeyVault&&j.KeyVault.Enabled===true&&j.ConnectionStrings.KeyVault===''?0:1)"` run from the worktree root exits 0.

Preserved, newly tested: a test in tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/Common/ProgramTests.cs builds the host (WebApplicationFactory<Program>, not IntegrationTestFactory) with `ConnectionStrings:KeyVault` set to an empty string and the Key Vault switch left unset, and asserts that startup throws InvalidOperationException whose message contains `Key Vault connection string cannot be empty.`; `dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/DMAuth.Tests.Integration.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ProgramTests"` reports `Failed:     0` and a Total of at least 1.

Demonstrated discrimination for the code default (amended A1, E3): ProgramTests.cs also holds Startup_WithNoAppSettingsFiles_ThrowsInvalidOperationException, which builds WebApplicationFactory<Program> on an empty content root so no appsettings file supplies the switch; inject a default of disabled into Program.cs's read of the Key Vault switch (name file:line), run only the --filter command above and report that this test fails, then revert and report the read-back of that line before running anything else.

The test factory disables Key Vault through the setting Program.cs actually reads, and no stale key remains: `grep -rn 'KeyVault:VaultUri' src tests --include=*.cs` prints nothing (it prints IntegrationTestFactory.cs:53 at ba33897). Control: `grep -rn 'GetConnectionString("KeyVault")' src --include=*.cs` still prints exactly one line, in src/DMAuth.Web/Program.cs.

Every test method this task adds is named MethodName_Scenario_ExpectedResult and its body is laid out with `// Arrange`, `// Act`, `// Assert` comment lines in that order (dotnet-tests.md, Naming and Structure).

tasks.title: DA-001 + IW-004: verify confidential client secrets at the token endpoint (client_secret_post) and keep the redirect URI's query in the code redirect
acceptance: Red-step protocol for every DA-001 handler test below marked `red`: add the client secret to the command first, write the test, run `dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ExchangeTokenHandlerTests|FullyQualifiedName~RotateTokenHandlerTests"` and report the assertion failure (not a compile error) for each `red` test before the handler check exists; then implement and report the same command with `Failed:     0`.

red: ExchangeTokenHandler, confidential client (ClientType.Confidential), wrong client secret: the result has IsSuccess false, ErrorType ResultError.Unauthorized and Error equal to `invalid_client`, and IAuthorizationCodeRepository.FindByCodeHashAsync is not received (DidNotReceive).
red: ExchangeTokenHandler, confidential client, no client secret supplied (null or empty): ResultError.Unauthorized with Error `invalid_client`, and FindByCodeHashAsync is not received.

red: ExchangeTokenHandler, confidential client whose ClientSecretHash is null: ResultError.Unauthorized with Error `invalid_client`, and the handler throws no exception (dotnet.md, Error handling: never throw for wrong credentials).
Preserved, newly tested: ExchangeTokenHandler, confidential client, correct client secret (IPasswordHasher.Verify returns true for it against the client's ClientSecretHash): the result is a success.
Preserved, newly tested (discussion D5): ExchangeTokenHandler, public client (ClientType.Public), no client secret: the result is a success and IPasswordHasher.Verify is not received.
red: RotateTokenHandler, confidential client, wrong client secret: ResultError.Unauthorized with Error `invalid_client`, and IRefreshTokenRepository.FindByTokenHashAsync is not received.
red: RotateTokenHandler, confidential client, no client secret supplied: ResultError.Unauthorized with Error `invalid_client`, and FindByTokenHashAsync is not received.
Preserved, newly tested: RotateTokenHandler, confidential client, correct client secret: the result is a success.
Preserved, newly tested (discussion D5): RotateTokenHandler, public client, no client secret: the result is a success and IPasswordHasher.Verify is not received.

The secret is verified against the stored hash in Application (backlog DA-001 Verify): `grep -rn "ClientSecretHash" src/DMAuth.Application --include=*.cs` prints at least one line (it prints none at ba33897).

Preserved, newly tested (client_secret_post, discussion D4): an integration test registers a Confidential client through POST /api/clients, obtains an authorization code through the consent flow, and POSTs /connect/token with grant_type=authorization_code and form field `client_secret` set to the secret returned at registration; the response is 200 and carries an access_token.
red: the same integration flow with no `client_secret` form field returns 401; report the 200 observed before the fix.
red: an integration test redeems a refresh token for a Confidential client (grant_type=refresh_token) with a wrong `client_secret` form field and gets 401; report the status observed before the fix.

No log call in Application or Web passes the client secret (backend.md, Logging: never log a secret or a credential): `grep -rnE 'Log[A-Za-z]*\(.*[Ss]ecret' src/DMAuth.Application src/DMAuth.Web --include=*.cs` prints nothing. Preserved by design: it prints nothing at ba33897.

red (IW-004): an integration test in tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/Auth/GrantConsentTests.cs registers a client whose only redirect URI is `https://example.com/callback?tenant=a`, POSTs /connect/consent with that redirect_uri and state `state123`, and asserts that the 302 Location starts with `https://example.com/callback?tenant=a&code=`, contains `&state=state123`, and contains exactly one `?`; report the Location observed before the fix (`...?tenant=a?code=...`).

Preserved, newly tested (IW-004): for the query-less redirect URI `https://example.com/callback`, the 302 Location from POST /connect/consent starts with `https://example.com/callback?code=` and contains `&state=state123`.
`dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj` reports `Failed:     0` and a Total greater than 234; report the Total.
`dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Integration/DMAuth.Tests.Integration.csproj` reports `Failed:     0` and a Total greater than the Total T2 reported; report the Total.
Every test method this task adds is named MethodName_Scenario_ExpectedResult (dotnet-tests.md, Naming).

Every test method this task adds lays out its body with `// Arrange`, `// Act`, `// Assert` comment lines in that order and asserts only with FluentAssertions, verifying substitute calls with NSubstitute `Received`/`DidNotReceive` (amended A4, E6; dotnet-tests.md, Structure, Assertions and Substitutes).

Every public member this task adds (the client secret on ExchangeTokenCommand, RotateTokenCommand and ExchangeTokenRequest) carries an XML documentation comment whose description sits on its own line indented two tabs after `///` (csharp-style.md, XML documentation comments).

tasks.title: DA-002: GrantConsent rejects an unregistered redirect URI or a disallowed scope; whole-solution gate
acceptance: red (backlog DA-002 Verify): a GrantConsentHandlerTests test sends a command whose RedirectUri is not in the client's RedirectUris and asserts IsSuccess false, ErrorType ResultError.Invalid, and that IAuthorizationCodeRepository.Add is not received; report the failure observed with `dotnet test tests/DMAuth.Tests.Unit/DMAuth.Tests.Unit.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GrantConsentHandlerTests"` before the fix.

red: a test with a RedirectUri that extends a registered one (registered `https://example.com/callback`, sent `https://example.com/callback/extra`) gets ResultError.Invalid and no IAuthorizationCodeRepository.Add, showing the match is exact.
red: a test whose GrantedScopes includes a scope not in the client's AllowedScopes gets ResultError.Invalid and no IAuthorizationCodeRepository.Add.
red: for the unregistered-redirect-URI command, IConsentRepository receives neither Add nor Update.
Preserved: the GrantConsentHandlerTests tests that exist at ba33897 (for example Handle_WithValidRequest_ReturnsSuccessWithPlainCode) still pass: the --filter command above reports `Failed:     0`.
Every test method this task adds is named MethodName_Scenario_ExpectedResult and lays out its body with `// Arrange`, `// Act`, `// Assert` comment lines (dotnet-tests.md, Naming and Structure).
Whole-solution gate: `dotnet build src/DM-Auth.sln`, run from the worktree root, exits 0, prints `0 Error(s)`, and its output contains no `NU1605`.

Whole-solution gate (dotnet.md, Solution and layers: `dotnet test src/DM-Auth.sln` from the repository root): `dotnet test src/DM-Auth.sln` exits 0 and prints two summary lines, DMAuth.Tests.Unit.dll and DMAuth.Tests.Integration.dll, each with `Failed:     0`; report both Totals.

tasks.title: FE-003 + FE-004: consent form posts to the API base URL; login classifies returnUrl
acceptance: Per Gate 2 D2 (amended A2, E4: plain `npm ci` fails EUSAGE on optional @emnapi peers under npm 11.6.2), the orchestrator runs `npm ci --legacy-peer-deps --prefix src/DMAuth.Client` in the worktree before this task is dispatched, and every npm criterion below runs against that install; `package.json` and `package-lock.json` are not changed by this task (`git diff --name-only -- src/DMAuth.Client/package.json src/DMAuth.Client/package-lock.json` prints nothing).

red (FE-003): a ConsentPage test stubs `VITE_API_BASE_URL` to `https://api.example.test/` and asserts the approve form's action is `https://api.example.test/connect/consent`; `npm --prefix src/DMAuth.Client run test -- src/pages/ConsentPage.test.tsx` reports the failure before the fix (action `/connect/consent`) and passes after.
Preserved, newly tested (FE-003, dev proxy): with `VITE_API_BASE_URL` unset, the approve form's action is `/connect/consent`.

FE-003 backlog Verify: `grep -n 'action=' src/DMAuth.Client/src/pages/ConsentPage.tsx` shows an action that is a JSX expression (`action={`), and `grep -c 'action="/connect/consent"' src/DMAuth.Client/src/pages/ConsentPage.tsx` prints 0 (it prints 1 at ba33897, ConsentPage.tsx:121).

The API base URL is read from the environment in one place (frontend.md, State ownership: every piece of state has exactly one owner): `grep -rl VITE_API_BASE_URL src/DMAuth.Client/src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --exclude=*.test.ts --exclude=*.test.tsx` lists exactly one file. Preserved by design: it lists only src/api/client.ts at ba33897.
Preserved, newly tested (FE-004): with returnUrl `/clients`, a successful sign-in lands on `/clients` through the router.

red (FE-004): with `VITE_API_BASE_URL` stubbed to `https://api.example.test/` and returnUrl `https://api.example.test/connect/authorize?client_id=dmauth_x&state=s1`, a successful sign-in calls `window.location.assign` with exactly that URL; report the failure observed before the fix with `npm --prefix src/DMAuth.Client run test -- src/pages/LoginPage.test.tsx`.
red (FE-004 backlog Verify): with returnUrl `//example.org`, a successful sign-in lands on `/dashboard` and `window.location.assign` is not called.

red: with `VITE_API_BASE_URL` stubbed to `https://api.example.test/` and returnUrl `https://evil.example/connect/authorize?client_id=dmauth_x`, a successful sign-in lands on `/dashboard` and `window.location.assign` is not called.

red: with `VITE_API_BASE_URL` stubbed to `https://api.example.test/` and returnUrl `https://api.example.test/api/users/me` (API origin, not the authorize path), a successful sign-in lands on `/dashboard` and `window.location.assign` is not called.

New and changed tests render through renderWithProviders, drive input with userEvent, and never query the DOM by selector (client-tests.md, Rendering, Interactions and Querying): `grep -nE 'querySelector|fireEvent' src/DMAuth.Client/src/pages/ConsentPage.test.tsx src/DMAuth.Client/src/pages/LoginPage.test.tsx` prints nothing. Preserved by design: it prints nothing at ba33897.
`npm --prefix src/DMAuth.Client run test` exits 0.

Lint (amended A3, E5: lint fails at ba33897 with 6 errors, 4 of them in files T5 does not own): eslint run from src/DMAuth.Client over T5's six owned files (`npx eslint src/pages/ConsentPage.tsx src/pages/ConsentPage.test.tsx src/pages/LoginPage.tsx src/pages/LoginPage.test.tsx src/api/client.ts src/api/client.test.ts`) exits 0, which clears the 2 `no-explicit-any` errors in src/api/client.test.ts at ba33897; and `npm --prefix src/DMAuth.Client run lint` reports exactly 4 errors, all in tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts, tests/e2e/fixtures/auth.ts and tests/e2e/profile.spec.ts, as at ba33897.
`npm --prefix src/DMAuth.Client run build` exits 0.
